relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Burn injury upregulated calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) expression in sensory neurones (1.5-fold; P=0.013) through transient receptor potential vanilloid 1 (TRPV1) channels.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: neurone-derived CGRP triggered SGC activation (from 6.8% pre-injury to 41.6% at day 5 post-injury)

relationships.subject: CXCL1
relationships.evidence_quote: chemokine expression (particularly CXCL1) in SGCs was elevated after burn injury, which potentiated sensory neurone excitability and exacerbated pain hypersensitivity

key_findings: Burn injury upregulates neuronal CGRP via TRPV1; blocking TRPV1/CGRP attenuates allodynia and hyperalgesia.
Neuronal CGRP activates SGCs and enhances gap junction coupling; SGC CXCL1 raises neuronal excitability.
